cases.summary: Discovers the standalone HTML diagram skill and applies local brand tokens without network access.
cases.setup: Use a disposable project with approved local brand tokens, a seven-component architecture description, protocols, directions, trust boundaries, no project diagram style file, and network access disabled.
cases.prompt: Create a standalone editorial HTML architecture diagram showing these components, protocols, directions, and trust boundaries. Use the supplied local brand tokens.
expectedBehavior: Discovers diagram-design without forced loading and does not route to raw SVG, D3, or infographic production.
Loads only bundled defaults, architecture guidance, and the selected template; applies request tokens without modifying the installed skill.
Writes one accessible offline HTML artifact with inline SVG, runs strict structural validation, and reports only visual checks actually performed.
forbiddenBehavior: Produces raw SVG as the only deliverable.
Loads network fonts or website resources.
Writes project branding into the installed diagram-design skill package.
Claims visual or accessibility checks that were not performed.

cases.summary: Uses selective loading and the complexity budget for a large cross-functional process.
cases.setup: Provide a 14-step process spanning four owners with two clear subprocesses, required handoffs, and a disposable output directory.
cases.prompt: Turn this process into a readable swimlane diagram in one standalone HTML file.
expectedBehavior: Loads only the swimlane type reference, resolved style guide, and one selected template.
Recognizes that the process exceeds one panel's complexity budget and either partitions overview and detail panels within one accessible SVG or asks one focused scope question.
Preserves every required step and handoff, adds accessible descriptions, validates the inline SVG, and inspects clipping separately when browser capability exists.
forbiddenBehavior: Loads every type reference or example.
Shrinks all labels into one unreadable diagram.
Treats validator success as proof of visual legibility.

cases.summary: Repairs structural, accessibility, and documented style failures in an existing HTML diagram.
cases.setup: Provide a standalone HTML fixture with duplicate SVG IDs, a broken marker reference, unresolved placeholders, four focal nodes, a simple shape outside the viewBox, missing SVG title and description, and one visible overlap.
cases.prompt: Audit and repair this diagram against the diagram-design system. Preserve its meaning and report checks actually run.
expectedBehavior: Discovers diagram-design for review and loads only the matching type, style, and validation guidance.
Repairs placeholders, IDs, references, bounds, accessible naming, focal hierarchy, and visible overlap without rebuilding unrelated content.
Runs the bundled validator until clean and records structural and browser visual evidence separately.
forbiddenBehavior: Removes required labels or meaning merely to pass checks.
Leaves unresolved references or inaccessible SVG content.
